rule: inLast subtracts civil calendar units in the catalog timezone while preserving local time; it never subtracts a fixed elapsed duration, so a one-day window across a spring-forward transition spans 23 elapsed hours.

datasets.description: Events around the 2024 New York spring-forward transition.

assertions: The anchor is 2024-03-11 01:30 local (UTC-04:00, after the transition).
One civil day earlier is 2024-03-10 01:30 local (UTC-05:00, before the transition), which is 2024-03-10T06:30:00Z.
The window therefore spans 23 elapsed hours, not 24.
elapsed-duration-only is 2024-03-10 00:45 local and is excluded; an implementation that subtracts a fixed 24 hours of absolute time includes it.
civil-lower-bound is exactly the inclusive lower boundary and at-anchor is exactly the inclusive upper boundary.
after-anchor is one second past the anchor and is excluded because inLast caps at the anchor.
